value: Employees of public utilities engaged in manufacture and distribution of electrical energy (terminates at first point of service attachment, except meters)
Employees/contractors of telecommunication carriers or satellite/cable systems providers acting in scope of employment
Employees/contractors of household appliance dealers installing appliances to existing electrical receptacles
Representatives of manufacturing firms installing/modifying controls on industrial machinery for the firm's own use, under direction of a registered professional engineer
Individuals installing a power limited system within a residential dwelling or installed with a factory connector/cord powered by existing electrical receptacle
Coal mine installations subject to federal mine safety and health administration jurisdiction
